narrative: Micron's June 25 print shows 16 take-or-pay Strategic Customer Agreements locking roughly $100 billion of minimum revenue plus $22 billion of upfront customer cash, with all 2026 HBM sold out and only half to two-thirds of demand fillable. When allocation is that scarce and pre-committed years out, paying forward or coupling capital to supply becomes the only way a frontier buyer guarantees memory.
remaining_gap: The disclosure names no frontier-lab counterparty and stops short of a disclosed equity coupling; the template is prepay take-or-pay, not a named OpenAI-memory-maker deal.
